## AI & Technology
In the realm of artificial intelligence, **[Anthropic surpasses OpenAI to become the most valuable AI startup](https://qazinform.com/news/anthropic-surpasses-openai-to-become-worlds-most-valuable-ai-startup)** marks a significant milestone, reflecting the fierce competition in the AI landscape. Additionally, **[Corporate America Is Starting to Ration AI as Cost Skyrockets](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/corporate-america-is-starting-to-ration-ai-as-cost-skyrockets-1eb99d7a)** highlights the economic pressures driving businesses to reconsider their AI investments. Another interesting read, **[Leo's first encyclical attacks technological messianism](https://www.economist.com/europe/2026/05/28/leos-first-encyclical-attacks-technological-messianism)**, critiques the over-reliance on technology in modern society.

## Software Development
For developers, **[Zig: Build System Reworked](https://ziglang.org/devlog/2026/#2026-05-26)** brings updates that enhance the Zig programming language's build process. Meanwhile, **[Pandoc Templates](https://pandoc-templates.org/)** offers a collection of useful templates for document conversion, making it easier for users to format their documents. Furthermore, **[Openrsync: An implementation of rsync, by the OpenBSD team](https://github.com/kristapsdz/openrsync)** presents a new tool for file synchronization that promises to improve performance and reliability.

## Science & Research
In scientific discussions, **[Proposed new US funding rules: We can cancel any grant at any time](https://arstechnica.com/science/2026/05/the-office-of-management-and-budget-tries-again-to-cripple-us-science/)** raises concerns about the potential impact on research funding stability. Also, **[What Happened to the Locusts?](https://explosion-scratch.github.io/locusts/)** explores the mysterious decline of locust populations, prompting discussions about ecological changes and their implications.

## Miscellaneous
In the miscellaneous category, **[IXI's autofocusing lenses are almost ready to replace multifocal glasses](https://www.engadget.com/wearables/ixis-autofocusing-lenses-multifocal-glasses-ces-2026-212608427.html)** introduces a new technology that could revolutionize vision correction.
